stories.title: WTA Beijing Final — Andreeva vs. Zheng, Home Crowd Dreams vs. No. 3 Destiny

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: History is on the line in Beijing 🎾 Qinwen Zheng is the first Chinese player EVER to reach the China Open women's final. She faces Mirra Andreeva, who rises to World No. 3 win or lose. Who wins the title? #WTATennis #ChinaOpen #WTA #TennisUpdate

x_posts.text: Andreeva enters the Beijing final having won her SF 6-2, 6-2. Zheng stunned Mertens 7-5, 6-2. The only time they've met before? Zheng won in the 2024 China Open QF — right here in Beijing. Full circle Sunday. #WTATennis #ChinaOpen #Andreeva #ZhengQinwen

x_posts.text: Carlos Alcaraz hadn't played in Shanghai in 730 days. He walked back on court Saturday and beat Cerundolo 6-3, 6-3 in 66 minutes. 24 winners. 78% first-serve percentage. And a new mustache. He said he missed this place. #Alcaraz #RolexShanghaiMasters #ATPTennis
